hypotheses.C1_spectral_strength_tracks_variance: On every corpus, median natural score variance of top-32 components is at least twice that of components 129–160.
hypotheses.C2_top_components_are_faithful: Top-32 components have median natural-score correlation at least 0.60 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_global_strength_variance_relation: Spearman correlation between singular value and natural score variance is at least 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_global_strength_fidelity_relation: Spearman correlation between singular value and score fidelity is at least 0.30 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_top4_cleaner_than_top32: Top-four median score correlation is at least the top-32 median on every corpus.
